    SELECT a.atom_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT c.atom_id) AS chlorine_cnt
    FROM atom a
    JOIN connected con ON con.atom_id = a.atom_id
    JOIN atom c ON c.atom_id = con.atom_id2
    WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR002'

    GROUP BY a.atom_id
),

    FROM atom a

    WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR002'
    GROUP BY a.atom_id
)
SELECT bc.atom_id,
       bc.total_bonds
FROM bond_counts bc
JOIN chlorine_counts cc ON cc.atom_id = bc.atom_id
WHERE cc.chlorine_cnt >= 2;

    SELECT atom_id, element
    FROM atom
    WHERE molecule_id = 'TR002'
),
chlorine_atoms AS (
    SELECT atom_id
    FROM tr002_atoms
    WHERE element = 'cl'
),
connections_within_tr002 AS (
    SELECT c.bond_id, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN tr002_atoms a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN tr002_atoms a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
),
atom_chlorine_neighbors AS (
    SELECT 
        nc.atom_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
            WHEN ch.atom_id = c.atom_id THEN c.atom_id2
            ELSE c.atom_id
        END) AS cl_neighbor_count
    FROM (SELECT atom_id FROM tr002_atoms WHERE element != 'cl') nc
    JOIN connections_within_tr002 c ON nc.atom_id = c.atom_id OR nc.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    JOIN chlorine_atoms ch ON ch.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
    GROUP BY nc.atom_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
            WHEN ch.atom_id = c.atom_id THEN c.atom_id2
            ELSE c.atom_id
        END) >= 2
)

FROM atom_chlorine_neighbors ach
JOIN connections_within_tr002 c ON ach.atom_id = c.atom_id OR ach.atom_id = c.atom_id2
GROUP BY ach.atom_id
ORDER BY ach.atom_id

    SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE molecule_id='TR002' AND element='cl'

 bonds AS (
    SELECT
        c.atom_id AS a1,
        c.atom_id2 AS a2,
        c.bond_id
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id

    WHERE a1.molecule_id='TR002' AND a2.molecule_id='TR002'

    FROM bonds b
    JOIN chlor cl ON b.a2 = cl.atom_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b.a2 AS atom_id, b.a1 AS neighbor_atom
    FROM bonds b
    JOIN chlor cl ON b.a1 = cl.atom_id
),
 qualifying_atoms AS (
    SELECT atom_id
    FROM chlorine_neighbors
    GROUP BY atom_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT neighbor_atom) >= 2
),
 atom_degree AS (
    SELECT
        d.atom_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.bond_id) AS total_bonds
    FROM (
        SELECT c.atom_id AS atom_id, c.bond_id FROM connected c
        UNION ALL
        SELECT c.atom_id2 AS atom_id, c.bond_id FROM connected c
    ) d
    JOIN atom a ON d.atom_id = a.atom_id
    WHERE a.molecule_id='TR002'
    GROUP BY d.atom_id
)
SELECT
    q.atom_id,
    d.total_bonds
FROM qualifying_atoms q
JOIN atom_degree d ON q.atom_id = d.atom_id;

meanings.gt_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE path_traversal AS (
    SELECT 
        a.molecule_id,
        a.atom_id AS start_atom,
        c.atom_id2 AS current_atom,
        1 AS depth
    FROM atom a
    JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
    WHERE a.element = 's'
    AND a.molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        pt.molecule_id,
        pt.start_atom,
        c.atom_id2,
        pt.depth + 1
    FROM path_traversal pt
    JOIN connected c ON pt.current_atom = c.atom_id
    WHERE pt.depth < 5
),
max_paths AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        MAX(depth) AS max_depth
    FROM path_traversal
    GROUP BY molecule_id
)
SELECT 
    max_depth
FROM max_paths
ORDER BY max_depth DESC

WITH total AS (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cnt
        FROM atom
        WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
    ),

        SELECT COUNT(*) AS chl_cnt
        FROM atom
        WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' AND element = 'cl'
    ),
    prop AS (
        SELECT CAST(chl_cnt AS REAL) / total_cnt AS proportion
        FROM total, chl
    ),
    elem_counts AS (
        SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM atom
        WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
        GROUP BY element
        ORDER BY cnt DESC, element

FROM prop, elem_counts;

),
